reports.title: Third Quarter 2026 Shareholder Letter OCTOBER 28, 2026 Exhibit 99.1

lines: We expect cash use of approximately $250 million during the fourth quarter of 2026 as we continue to scale our driverless fleet.
Reflecting a production ramp about six weeks behind our prior plan, we now expect 2026 revenue of approximately $9 million, which continues to represent substantial year-over-year growth.
